_readme: Dated structural events in Indian equity markets that change what a backtest can assume.
This is a curated reference list, NOT a complete history and NOT a news archive.
verified=false means the entry was written from memory and must be checked against the cited
primary source (NSE / SEBI circular) before it is relied upon. Add or correct entries here;
the engine and the research agents read this file at run time.

events.title: NSE cash (capital market) segment begins screen-based trading
events.effect: No NSE equity backtest can start earlier.

events.title: NIFTY 50 index launched (base date 1995-11-03 = 1000)
events.effect: Index values before launch are back-computed.

events.title: Dematerialised settlement begins (NSDL)
events.effect: Earlier settlement was physical-certificate based; liquidity and costs are not comparable.

events.title: Index futures (NIFTY 50) launched
events.effect: No NSE futures backtest can start earlier.

events.title: Index options launched
events.effect: No NSE options backtest can start earlier.

events.title: Single-stock options launched
events.effect: Stock options unavailable earlier.

events.title: Single-stock futures launched
events.effect: Stock futures unavailable earlier.

events.title: T+2 rolling settlement
events.effect: Settlement cycle shortened from T+3.

events.title: Securities Transaction Tax introduced
events.effect: No STT before this date; the charge schedule in charges_in.json does not cover this period.

events.title: BANKNIFTY derivatives launched
events.effect: BANKNIFTY F&O unavailable earlier.

events.title: Currency futures (USDINR) launched on NSE
events.effect: Currency derivatives unavailable earlier.

events.title: Pre-open call auction session introduced
events.effect: Opening prices before/after are formed differently; open-based strategies see a structural break.

events.title: BANKNIFTY weekly options introduced
events.effect: Weekly-expiry option strategies impossible earlier.

events.title: NIFTY weekly options introduced
events.effect: Weekly-expiry NIFTY option strategies impossible earlier.

events.title: All stock derivatives physically settled (phased in from July 2018)
events.effect: Expiry risk for stock F&O changes: delivery obligations and higher margins near expiry. The engine approximates with cash settlement and flags it.

events.title: Market-wide circuit breaker triggered (also 2020-03-23)
events.effect: Trading halts; simulated fills during halts are unrealistic.

events.title: Uniform stamp duty on securities transactions
events.effect: State-specific duty replaced; modelled from this date in charges_in.json.

events.title: Peak-margin framework phase 1 (25%), reaching 100% on 2021-09-01
events.effect: Intraday leverage progressively capped (about 5x for equities from Sep 2021). Earlier intraday leverage was far higher.

events.title: FINNIFTY derivatives launched
events.effect: FINNIFTY F&O unavailable earlier.

events.title: T+1 settlement for all equities
events.effect: Settlement cycle shortened from T+2.

events.title: STT on F&O raised (futures 0.0125%, options 0.0625%)
events.effect: Cost structural break for derivatives.

events.title: STT on F&O raised (futures 0.02%, options 0.1%); NSE moves to uniform transaction charges
events.effect: Cost structural break for derivatives.

events.title: SEBI index-derivatives framework: one weekly expiry per exchange, larger contract sizes
events.effect: BANKNIFTY/FINNIFTY/MIDCPNIFTY weekly options discontinued; index lot sizes raised. Weekly-expiry strategies on those indices cannot be traded after this date.

events.title: NSE index derivatives expiry day moved from Thursday to Tuesday
events.effect: Day-of-week expiry effects change.

events.title: STT on F&O raised (futures 0.05%, options 0.15%, exercise 0.15%)
events.effect: Cost structural break for derivatives.
